title: Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft in chemical processing environments where resistance to HCl and H₂SO₄ at temperatures up to 200°C exceeds the capability of CP grades. The molybdenum and nickel additions stabilize the passive film under reducing acid conditions, extending service life in Autoclave agitator shaft (Grade 5) by 3-5× versus unalloyed titanium. This rationale is driven by autoclave agitator shaft (grade 5) and fat life requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for reactor hardware geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with SPC sampling
TIG welding Grade 2 with SPC sampling
Hydrostatic shell test with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for autoclave agitator shaft application
commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability — critical for autoclave agitator shaft performance

faq.q: How does Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft perform in chloride-containing process streams?
faq.a: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni is the material of choice for wet chlorine, hypochlorite, and chlorinated organic media where stainless steels (316L, 904L) pit within weeks. The TiO₂ passive film maintains stability in chloride concentrations up to saturated levels at pH 2-12 for autoclave agitator shaft. No critical pitting temperature up to 260°C — significantly exceeding all stainless steel grades.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft?
faq.a: Each Titanium Reactor Agitator Shaft shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for autoclave agitator shaft.
